headline: Palantine Berm Leads Renewed Front-Line Struggle
war_summary: Since the last edition, Palantine Berm remains the busiest ledger, rising to fifty-three strategic-base events in twenty-four hours and three in the latest two; its balance has shifted to four Warden, three Colonial, and no neutral bases. Weathered Expanse has likewise advanced to twenty-seven daily events, with three Warden, four Colonial, and two neutral holdings, while casualties and enlistments accelerate on both sides. Linn Mercy records twenty-four events, including four in two hours, and now lists eight Colonial bases, three neutral, and none Warden—a notable change from the previous report. Marban Hollow has eased slightly to twenty-six daily events but still shows a divided field: six Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral base. Nevish Line retains seven Warden and one Colonial base, with eleven daily events but none in the latest two hours. Mooring County has cooled completely in the latest six hours after thirteen daily events, its twelve Warden bases presently intact. Stonecradle has also stirred, posting two events in two hours. No victor is declared.
